description: Sync one project's team memory on this computer with SystemDox: pull the files the team changed, push the ones changed here, keep both texts of a file changed on both sides. It never answers for a person: a file that still holds a phone number, an email address or a home-folder path is skipped and listed, with the command for the member to run in their own terminal (`npx -y @systemdox/mcp-server sync-memory`). Pass dryRun to see what it would do without writing or sending anything.

dryRun.description: Show what would be pulled, pushed, deleted, conflicted and skipped, and change nothing

project.description: The project's team memory, e.g. puglieseweb-ltd; needed when the workspace has more than one

name: sync_memory
title: Sync Memory
